description: Make a short video when someone asks for a clip, a video or an animation, and call it before you say so.

offer.reason: offered only to an adult on their own written screen, when the household has video on and the Stack has a video model

author: MaiPai

examples: make a short video of a paper boat in the rain
can you generate a video of a dragon flying over a castle
make a clip of waves on a beach at sunset
turn that picture into a video
create a short animation of a robot waving hello

prompt.description: What the video shows, written as a full description in plain English: the subject, what moves, the setting and the light or mood, built from what the person asked for. For a picture that moves, describe the motion. Keep their own words for names. Follow the model's content rules and refusal decisions; Home blocks CSAM and applies age and surface access rules. Do not add people, objects or themes they did not ask for. A video exists only if you called this tool in this reply: never say one is being made, ready or on its way without calling it, and never describe a clip you did not make. A line a person in the video says goes in quotes, one person speaking at a time.

from_picture.description: Optional. Set to "latest" only when the person asks to animate or bring to life a picture that was made earlier in this chat. Set to "attached" when the person attached a photo to this message and asks to animate it. Leave it out for a video from words alone.

orientation.description: Optional shape of the video. landscape is the default. Use portrait only for a phone-style tall video when the person asks.

look.description: Optional look of the video: natural (the default), classic-cartoon (a 1980s hand-drawn cartoon), anime, 3d-animated (a modern 3D animated film) or film (a live-action movie still). Set it only when the person asks for a look or a cartoon. For a cartoon character, also name and describe the character in the prompt and say its era and animation style, for example a 1980s hand-drawn cartoon fox in a red scarf.

camera.description: Optional camera move or style: dolly-in, slow-orbit, handheld, slow-motion, time-lapse, aerial, close-up or still. Set it only when the person asks for that kind of shot.

voices.description: Optional sound for any clip that has sound (Standard or Boost on a computer with the newest video model, else Boost or Max). clean (the default) means no laugh track and no music, and one person speaks at a time. full means music and sound effects too; use it only when the person asks for music or effects. A person's spoken line goes in the prompt inside quotes, and only one person speaks at a time.

seconds.description: Optional length in seconds, 1 to 10. Leave it out for 5. On a computer with the newest video model, Standard makes up to 10 seconds with sound and Boost makes up to 5 seconds with sound; otherwise Standard makes 5 seconds at most and a longer video is made at Boost automatically. When a length is cut to fit, the tool says so and you tell the person. A video that starts from a picture is 5 seconds at most and has no sound.

tier.description: Optional level: standard, boost or max. Leave it out for almost every request; Home then uses the household's setting. Use boost when the person wants a better one, or, on a computer where Standard has no sound, wants people to speak, wants sound or music, or wants more than 5 seconds. Use max only when they ask for max quality or the biggest model; it is for people an admin allowed, and if it is not allowed the tool says so and you tell the person in your own words. Use standard for "just a quick one", for a longer clip with sound when the tool allows it, or when they want it to start from a picture. Do not use it for age or content reasons.

style.description: Optional. The name of one of the household's saved video styles, only when the person names it. Leave it out otherwise; never invent one.
